extDescription.message: Restore the Gulf of Mexico, Lake Ontario, and any other renamed place on Google Maps.

tagline.message: Control what Google Maps calls things.

scopeNotice.message: Gazetteer renames places in the sidebar, in search results, in the tab title, and on the map itself. If a label was already on screen before you saved a change, it updates the next time the map redraws. Pan, zoom, or reload the tab to see it right away.

rasterToggleHint.message: While the map loads, Google briefly shows a preview image that still has the old names on it. With this on, you see a plain gray loading grid instead, and the first names to appear are your renamed ones. Turns itself off on computers that can't run the full map.

searchToggleLabel.message: Show renamed places in the search box

searchToggleHint.message: After a search, Maps fills the search box with a place's old name. With this on, the box shows your renamed version instead. One thing to know: searching again will look up the renamed text, and an invented name may find nothing. Text you type yourself is never changed.

backupHint.message: Export saves your renames to a file, for backup or for sharing. Import replaces everything with the contents of a file.

emptyRules.message: No places configured yet. Add one below.

confirmRestore.message: Replace all your renames with the shipped defaults?

statusNoLocaleRules.message: No rules active for this language

contestedWarning.message: Two of your places share a word on the map, and a label drawn earlier may show the wrong one. Reload the tab to redraw.

offsite.message: Open Google Maps to see status here.

importErrNotObject.message: The file is not a JSON object.

importErrRenameNotObject.message: Rename $2 in "$1" is not an object.

importErrTooLarge.message: The file is larger than 1 MB.

importErrNotJson.message: The file is not valid JSON.

importErrNotSaved.message: The renames could not be saved. Chrome may be out of storage space.
